主要内容: TowerSec was named the Hottest Startup in 2015 at the North American International Auto Show (NAIAS) for its work on automotive cyber security. Its ECUSHIELD onboard software will stop vehicle cyber threats now and in the future. The cost of the onboard software is less than $10 per vehicle. It requires a single installation, needs no redesign and can be easily updated. Bruce Coventry, chairman of TowerSec, stated that vehicles today have more connectivity than personal computers, opening the door to hackers and cyber attacks that compromise automotive safety and security. ECUSHIELD provides continuous updates and identifies new threats to the vehicle, preventing malicious communication intrusions from reaching mission critical systems inside the vehicle. TowerSec, founded in 2012 by an Israeli team with automotive manufacturing experience and cyber security expertise, combines auto industry knowledge with Israeli cyber security to deliver its on-board solutions. It maintains offices in Ann Arbor, Michigan, and Munich, Germany, with an R&D center in Tel-Aviv, Israel.
